title: Edge Personalization POC Kickoff Playbook
summary: Kickoff playbook for a 6-week proof-of-concept with Meridian Retail to validate on-edge personalization for in-store kiosks using Redwood Private. Goals: evaluate latency/throughput at the edge, measure personalization uplift, and validate secure model sync to air-gapped devices.
primary_objectives: Deploy Redwood Private control plane in Meridian VPC (staging)
Provision lightweight on-prem inference adapters for four pilot kiosks
Measure end-to-end 95th percentile latency under burst traffic
Quantify offline personalization quality lift vs baseline
scope_included: Pilot covers 4 in-store kiosks in two regions, a subset of the personalization model (distilled transformer ~1.5B parameters), a sync workflow for incremental user preferences, and instrumentation for token-level cost and latency. Redwood Dedicated and hosted API are out of scope for this POC but will be referenced for cost comparisons.
out_of_scope: Full fleet rollout, integration with POS payment flows, deep privacy/legal assessments (will require separate engagement), custom model retraining pipelines beyond lightweight fine-tuning.
success_criteria: E2E 95th percentile response latency < 80ms for 1k concurrent kiosk sessions
Personalization NDCG@5 increase >= 12% vs baseline rules-based recommender
Sync window for preference updates < 5 minutes in normal conditions
Secure key rotation validated with customer KMS and audit logs present in Console
acceptance_tests: Simulated traffic run: 1k concurrent sessions for 30 minutes with KV-cache enabled (pass if p95 < 80ms and <1% errors)
A/B offline eval: compare distilled model recommendations to baseline on historical logs (target NDCG uplift >= 12%)
Network partition test: validate kiosk continues serving cached responses for at least 10 minutes when control plane unreachable
Audit verification: confirm logs and KMS entries appear in Console and are retained for 30 days
milestones: Week 0: Alignment + access (NDA, VPN, staging VPC access, data checklist)
Week 1: Private control plane deploy + model install on two kiosks (region A)
Week 2: Telemetry and KV cache tuning, run baseline traffic tests
Week 3: Deploy remaining kiosks (region B) + A/B evaluation start
Week 5: Final evaluation, cost analysis and rollback/fallback plan
Week 6: Hand-off, lessons learned, draft deployment proposal for production
workshop_agenda: Architecture walkthrough (20m): Redwood Private, kiosk agent, sync path
Data readiness (15m): sample payloads, PII checklist
Performance knobs (20m): batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs
Resiliency drills (15m): expected failures and fallbacks
Operational runbooks (15m): monitoring, alerts, rollback steps
resources_required: Staging VPC with bastion host and minimum 4 vCPUs per kiosk adapter
Access to sample event streams (anonymized) for 30 days of interaction logs
Customer KMS credentials (test key) for POC
Small GPU node (1x A10 or equivalent) for model distillation/fine-tune steps
known_risks_and_mitigations: Network constraints at store: plan for asymmetric sync windows and validate offline cache behavior
PII in logs: require strict anonymization and signed attestation before data leaves store
Model size vs kiosk memory: prepare quantized model fallback and a shorter context mode
Unexpected latency from third-party integrations: stub external calls for POC
operational_playbacks: Nightly automated perf run with synthetic traffic and report to shared Slack channel
Weekly sync between Redwood SE and Meridian infra to unblock access issues
Post-mortem template ready for any >1% error spike events
deliverables: Deployed Redwood Private staging environment and 4 kiosk adapters
Performance report with latency percentiles, cost per 1k queries, and A/B recommendation metrics
Resiliency report with results from partition and restart tests
Hand-off doc and production rollout checklist
budget_estimate: Estimated incremental POC spend: $12k for infra (staging + 4 kiosks), $6k for SE effort (time & travel if onsite), and $2k miscellaneous (licenses, test devices). Final estimate contingent on customer-provided devices.
next_steps: Customer to provide 30 days of anonymized logs by 2024-11-12
Schedule Week 0 alignment call (Sofia/Leah/Omar) — propose 2024-11-07 11:00 PT
Provision staging VPC and open required ports by 2024-11-09
notes: This playbook emphasizes validation of edge resiliency and measurable personalization uplift rather than full production economics. Keep scope tight: one distilled model variant + robust caching strategy. If early results show strong uplift, prepare a Dedicated vs Private cost comparison in week 5.
